description:
Searches Brazilian federal laws for an agent, paid per call: up to 20 items, with no account.
The search of `GET /api/legislation/search`, sold per call to agents, with no account and no allowance before. A request without payment gets the 402 with the price; a paid one gets the items in the same response, with the payment in `cobranca`. Send at least one of `q`, `type`, `year` or `authority`. A refused search and an unavailable corpus are not charged. Full-text search covers title, description and body. Number/year uses an exact indexed lookup. Source metadata is not a verification of legal currency. No state or municipal laws in this collection.

after.description: Cursor from next. Do not generate a cursor.

authority.description: Issuing body declared by the source: congresso-nacional, presidencia-da-republica or unknown. The provider is separate.

q.description: Number/year, such as 10406/2002, or words. At most 160 characters. LGPD, CDC and Código Civil aliases are supported.

type.description: constituicao, leis-ordinarias, leis-complementares, leis-delegadas or decretos-lei.

name: get_api_x402_legislation
title: Get API X402 legislation
